conditional_rgb.primary: 24 sealed post-cutoff RGB images with edge/normal conditions
conditional_rgb.supplement: COCO val2017, 24 fixed images, high contamination risk

semantic_estimation.primary: 24 frozen AVIS test RGB/channel-103 pairs with the native WSM ontology
semantic_estimation.supplement: An external human-parsing benchmark with an explicit mapping to the six WSM classes
semantic_estimation.note: AVIS test is a held-out split with same-frame RGB and exact MediaPipe-103 GT alignment. External human-parsing labels may be used only after freezing an auditable mapping into the six classes; unmappable labels are ignored, never guessed. Report WSM as held-out test inference unless training provenance proves the entire AVIS dataset was unseen; official external baselines are zero-shot on AVIS.

any_to_any.primary: 24 sealed cross-modal pairs covering RGB/edge/normal/depth conversions
any_to_any.supplement: NYUv2 or equivalent paired subset, 24 fixed images, contamination risk

depth_estimation.primary: 24 sealed post-cutoff RGB/depth pairs with metric or affine-invariant depth
depth_estimation.supplement: Marigold official evaluation mirror (NYUv2/KITTI/ETH3D/DIODE), 24 fixed images
